criteria.D: A fitted affine probe predicts the specified target on independent held-out examples. Identify the target encoding and the split; successful reconstruction or a nonlinear decoder alone does not establish this criterion.
criteria.E: An affine probe uses fewer labels or has lower complexity at comparable prediction error, or a shorter total description length. Name the comparator and cost. Accuracy alone does not measure efficiency.
criteria.I: A frozen probe or identified structure transfers across target-preserving changes in contexts, domains, or values. Compare frozen-probe performance or separately fitted structures. Refitting and testing only within each context does not test transfer.
criteria.N: Removing candidate information impairs the specified behavior, with other relevant information preserved. Identify the removed object, baseline, behavioral error, and collateral effects. Ablating the complement tests retention of the candidate.
criteria.R: Directions or subspaces agree across changes in fitted samples, analysis choices, or model training. Repeated prediction scores and the recurrence of a broad visual pattern provide weaker evidence than comparisons of the fitted objects.
criteria.SC: Activation-space objects preserve independently specified target relations, such as distances, hierarchy, or operations. State the target relation and the geometric comparison; classification alone leaves this criterion unresolved.
criteria.S_C: Setting candidate content induces the predicted target behavior under a specified background and intervention policy. Report exact success, partial effects, and off-target changes at the tested activation sites.
criteria.S_M: A proposed representation and its transformations explain ordinary computation and intervention effects. Quantitative reconstruction is the formal criterion; circuit localization or partial computational accounts can provide limited evidence.

method: Source-checked automated adjudication, with three parallel assessments and reconciliation. These ratings are interpretive judgments; no independent human double coding or inter-rater reliability estimate is available.
